title: Keep a field notebook and bring jaunts into lessons
items: Home's Photo and share tools save a stamped picture and a link to the view. Captures happen only when asked, with a bounded image size.
Guide's Field notebook keeps notes, selected people with their sources and small photo copies in this browser. Download the notebook or print it to save a PDF.
Completed jaunts offer three optional, ungraded reflections from the cited evidence you visited, with source review and another try.
For teachers adds printable group lesson guides with document tasks, discussion prompts and suggested Illinois and C3 standards connections.
